reviews.text: A lot smaller than I thought but great for on the go. Soft and spreads lip product well enough, but also absorbs a lot of product
reviews.zh: 比我想像中細好多，但好啱帶出街用。好柔軟，唇部產品推得夠開，但都好吸產品。

reviews.text: Es práctico y cabe muy bien en la bolsa, sinceramente me encanta que sea plateado además cumple muy bien con su función. ^_−☆
reviews.zh: 佢實用，放落袋入面好啱，講真我好鍾意佢係銀色嘅，而且完全做到佢應有嘅功能。^_^☆

reviews.text: Its so cute!!! Its a super cute and small brush, perfect for not taking up space in your space.
reviews.zh: 好得意！！！超得意又細支嘅掃，唔佔空間一流。

reviews.text: It's a shame, but I didn't receive this brush, it wasn't included in the package, I hope they'll return my money
reviews.zh: 好可惜，我冇收到呢支掃，包裹入面冇，希望可以退錢俾我。

reviews.text: This is very tiny and perfect for my makeup bag. It's about the same size as a perfume sample that you get for free from S*ph*ra. I liked that this had a ballchain on it and I wish the silicon brush version had the chain too.
reviews.zh: 呢個好細，啱晒放落化妝袋。Size 大概同一個 S*ph*ra 免費送嘅香水 sample 差唔多。鍾意佢有個波波鏈，希望矽膠掃嗰款都有鏈。

reviews.text: Really cute, and goes well with the lipsleek, but it doesn't pick up a lot of product and is very hard to clean
reviews.zh: 真係好靚，同 lipsleek 好夾，但唔夠沾到好多產品，而且好難清潔。

reviews.text: super light . really cute brush. really nice to brush on the lip. i wish the chain came in longer length
reviews.zh: 超輕。真係好得意嘅掃。掃上唇好舒服。希望條鏈可以長啲。

reviews.text: Amazing tool! Love the bouncy material and makes it easier to apply certain products. I have long nails so this really makes it better
reviews.zh: 勁好用嘅工具！鍾意佢嗰種有彈性嘅材質，搽某啲產品嘅時候方便咗好多。我指甲留得長，用呢個方便好多。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
